title: Equality of tree circuit classes
statement: The class formed by taking the union, over all integers $i\ge 1$, of languages recognized by polynomial-size tree-circuit families with fan-in at most two and depth at most $b(\log_2 n+1)^i$ for some constant $b$ is equal to the class formed by taking the union over all natural numbers $i$ of languages recognized by polynomial-size tree-circuit families with depth at most $b(\log_2 n+1)^i$ for some constant $b$.
